opening.argument: The central Fortnite segment presents an investigation into an extraordinary V-Bucks offer, not an endorsement of it. The creator explains that they found someone who “actually runs one of these websites,” while the third party demands, “your password username first,” claims to add millions of V-Bucks, and then says, “you can leave the account with me so you don't get banned.” The creator expresses doubt and closes with the warning, “I'm pretty sure that accounts will get scammed or banned,” making the risk to viewers explicit. Separately, the AppBounty promotion describes earning credits by “downloading + opening free apps & completing tasks” for gift cards. The supplied evidence does not show that promotion requesting Fortnite credentials or promising V-Bucks directly.
